subject: Gradual provisioning & multi-year prepay — HelixAI Dedicated proposal
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@helixai.com>
Cc: Maya Sinha <maya.s@helixai.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Draft proposal: Dedicated capacity + phased provisioning

Hi Sanjay / Maya,

Thanks again for the time this morning. Attached is our draft dedicated proposal that reflects the high-level needs you shared: multi-year prepay with a gradual provisioning profile (lower initial commit, step-ups in year 2/3), and the ability to burst during model launches.

Highlights:
- Year 1: 80 reserved A100-equivalent GPU TPMs baseline, with burst pool of 20 for launches.
- Year 2: auto-increase to 160 TPMs on the 12-month anniversary (subject to a 30-day notice).
- Year 3: increase to 240 TPMs.
- Term discount: 18% off list for a 3-year upfront prepay.
- Included: SOC2 evidence package, monthly usage reporting, rollout support (two onsite/virtual days).

I attached: Helix_Redwood_Dedicated_Proposal_v3.pdf and a simple CSV ramp schedule (helix_ramp_schedule_v3.csv) so procurement can drop numbers into your internal models.

Open items we flagged:
- Exact billing cadence for year-by-year increases (invoice timing and proration).
- SLA carveouts for planned scale events.
- Acceptable PO/process for onboarding credits during the ramp (if you want a trial period).

If this looks directionally right, can we sync mid-next-week to lock down ramp dates and signature path? If procurement prefers, we can also provide a version with annual prepay instead of full upfront.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
Attachment: Helix_Redwood_Dedicated_Proposal_v3.pdf (PDF, 1 page summary)
Attachment: helix_ramp_schedule_v3.csv (CSV stub)

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@helixai.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Sinha <maya.s@helixai.com>, Procurement <procurement@helixai.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft proposal: Dedicated capacity + phased provisioning

Evelyn —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear docs. A few high-level asks from our side after reviewing with engineering and finance:

1) Year 1 exposure: 80 TPMs is higher than we can commit for the first 6 months. Can we move to a 40 TPM baseline for months 0–6, ramp to 100 TPMs months 7–12, then hit 160 on the 12-month mark? We need to align with our hiring/product roadmap.

2) Discount cadence: 18% for full 3-year upfront is attractive, but finance is asking if there's a stepped discount if we do annual prepays (year-by-year) — for example: 12% year1 prepay, 15% year2 prepay, 18% year3 when committed up front.

3) Proration and invoice timing: if we increase mid-quarter, how do you handle proration? We need net-30 terms on any invoices for the committed capacity piece.

4) Trial allowance: Can we request a 30-day onboarding credit for initial tests before the first prepay milestone?

I'll loop procurement and legal if we have a path. Happy to discuss on a quick call.

—Sanjay
Head of Infrastructure, HelixAI

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@helixai.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft proposal: Dedicated capacity + phased provisioning

Thanks Sanjay —

Looping in Lauren (AE) and Aditya (SE) to propose a concrete schedule and pricing that addresses your asks. Short answers:
- We can do a 40 TPM baseline for months 0–6 and a mid-year step to 100 TPMs, then to 160 at 12 months.
- We can offer stepped discounts for annual prepay as you suggested; will propose specific %s.
- Proration: standard monthly proration for mid-quarter increases; we’ll formalize in the SOW. Net-30 for committed invoices is OK (we’ll reflect that in the terms).
- 30-day onboarding credit: yes, subject to a short onboarding acceptance test (basically a readiness sign-off).

Aditya / Lauren — can you draft a counter with the stepped discount table and how we’d handle billing/proration? Also include language for burst pool billing and capacity guarantees during launches.

Thanks,
Evelyn

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@helixai.com>, Maya Sinha <maya.s@helixai.com>, Procurement <procurement@helixai.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal update: stepped prepay + gradual provisioning (HelixAI)

Hi Sanjay / Maya / Procurement team —

Thanks for the feedback. Attached is an updated term summary (Redwood_Dedicated_Terms_Summary.docx) and an annotated ramp CSV that reflects the 40->100->160->240 progression you described. Highlights of our counter:  

- Capacity schedule (provisioning by month):
  * Months 0–6: 40 reserved TPMs (baseline)
  * Months 7–12: 100 reserved TPMs
  * Month 13 (12-month anniversary): 160 reserved TPMs
  * Year 3: 240 reserved TPMs on month 25

- Pricing and discounts (options):
  Option A: 3-year upfront prepay — 18% off list across all years (single invoice).
  Option B: Annual prepay (preferred by Helix per earlier note) — stepped discounts: Year1 prepay: 12% off list; Year2 prepay: 15%; Year3 prepay: 18% (applies if Year3 invoice settled by signing anniversary).
  Option C: 12-month commit with quarterly true-ups — 10% off list with limited burst credits.

- Billing/proration: mid-quarter increases will be prorated to the day; committed invoices billed net-30. Bursts beyond reserved TPMs billed at an overage rate (listed in the attached PDF).

- Onboarding credit: one 30-day onboarding credit equivalent to 2 weeks of reserved capacity (applied against first invoice) — contingent on a successful onboarding acceptance test we’ll run with Aditya.

Next steps:
1) Procurement — if Option B (annual prepay) is acceptable, we’ll prepare a contract with the stepped discount table and the proration clause.
2) Legal/procurement — redline review; we can accept a limited set of standard procurement edits.
3) DocuSign link will be provided once redlines are agreed; proposed signature path is procurement -> finance -> CTO.

Attachments: Redwood_Dedicated_Terms_Summary.docx, helix_ramp_schedule_v3.csv

Happy to hop on a 30-min call early next week to finalize.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

From: Procurement <procurement@helixai.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@helixai.com>, Maya Sinha <maya.s@helixai.com>, legal@helixai.com
Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal update: stepped prepay + gradual provisioning (HelixAI)

Lauren / Evelyn —

Thanks — procurement and legal reviewed the summary. A few practical asks before we circulate to finance/CTO:

- Please add explicit language that Year1 baseline (Months 0–6 at 40 TPMs) is cancellable with 60 days notice and a limited termination fee (we propose 10% of remaining committed value). We need a short-term escape for business model risk.
- Can you add a clause specifying the proration formula in the SOW (monthly pro rata based on days in the month) rather than a generic proration reference?
- Net-30 for committed invoices is fine; we need a plain-English explanation for burst charges and an illustrative example in the SOW.
- Request a DocuSign-ready contract with our standard PO reference field populated (PO#: HELIX-PO-2026-1123).

Also, legal flagged a request to cap the overage billing in the first 90 days of each ramp event to avoid surprises.

If you can incorporate those items, we’ll circulate an internal redline and aim to return within 3 business days.

Regards,
HelixAI Procurement
Attachment: none

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Agreed negotiation points to prepare redline

Team — summary of agreed positions to include in the redline package for HelixAI (docs attached):

1) Use Option B (Annual prepay with stepped discounts) as primary — Year1: 12%, Year2: 15%, Year3: 18%.
2) Implement the 40/100/160/240 provisioning schedule as Lauren drafted; include explicit month markers in the SOW.
3) Add termination safeguard: allow cancellation of Year1 baseline with 60 days notice and a 10% remaining-commitment termination fee (compromise to procurement request).
4) Express proration formula explicitly: monthly pro rata by days; include example calculation in Appendix A.
5) Cap overage billing during the first 90 days after each step increase to no more than 25% above forecasted bursts; will be defined as a soft cap with exception process.
6) Net-30 for committed invoices; onboarding credit applied to first invoice after acceptance sign-off.
7) Prepare DocuSign-ready contract with PO field HELIX-PO-2026-1123 and HubSpot deal ID DEAL-2026-043 in contract metadata.

Aditya — please prepare the onboarding acceptance test plan and a short illustrative billing example we can embed into the SOW. Lauren — please update the terms doc and the ramp CSV and push to the HubSpot deal. Steph — coordinate legal to accept the termination fee language (10% of remaining committed value) and the 90-day cap phrasing.

I’ll send the redline to Sanjay / procurement once we have the updated SOW and terms.

Evelyn
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
